<?xml version='1.0' encoding='utf-8'?> <mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="State Diagram - ATM" id="atm_state_diagram"> <mxGraphModel dx="1422" dy="762" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1260" pageHeight="600" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{"data": "@startuml
skinparam monochrome false
skinparam roundcorner 10
skinparam shadowing false

skinparam state {
 BackgroundColor White
 BorderColor #2C3E50
 ArrowColor #2980B9
 StartColor #27AE60
 EndColor #C0392B
}

[*] --> WaitingState : [totalCash > 0]
[*] --> BlockedState : [totalCash == 0]

state WaitingState as \"WaitingState\n(Ожидание)\" {
 WaitingState : entry / ожидание клиента
 WaitingState : loadCash(amount) [amount > 0] / totalCash += amount
 WaitingState : withdrawCash(amount) / отказ
 WaitingState : finishSession() / отказ
}

state AuthenticationState as \"AuthenticationState\n(Аутентификация пользователя)\" {
 AuthenticationState : entry / проверка связи с банком и PIN-кода
 AuthenticationState : enterPin(pin) [нет связи или неверный PIN] / повторный ввод
 AuthenticationState : withdrawCash(amount) / отказ
 AuthenticationState : loadCash(amount) / отказ
}

state PerformingOperationsState as \"PerformingOperationsState\n(Выполнение операций)\" {
 PerformingOperationsState : entry / доступ к операциям открыт
 PerformingOperationsState : withdrawCash(amount) [связь есть и amount < totalCash] / выдача
 PerformingOperationsState : withdrawCash(amount) [нет связи или amount > totalCash] / отказ
 PerformingOperationsState : enterPin(pin) / отказ
 PerformingOperationsState : loadCash(amount) / отказ
}

state BlockedState as \"BlockedState\n(Заблокирован: денег нет)\" {
 BlockedState : entry / выдача заблокирована (totalCash == 0)
 BlockedState : enterPin(pin) / отказ
 BlockedState : withdrawCash(amount) / отказ
 BlockedState : finishSession() / отказ
}

WaitingState --> AuthenticationState : enterPin(pin) [нет связи или неверный PIN]
AuthenticationState --> WaitingState : finishSession()
WaitingState --> PerformingOperationsState : enterPin(pin) [связь есть и PIN верный]
AuthenticationState --> PerformingOperationsState : enterPin(pin) [связь есть и PIN верный]
PerformingOperationsState --> WaitingState : finishSession()
PerformingOperationsState --> BlockedState : withdrawCash(amount) [amount == totalCash]
BlockedState --> WaitingState : loadCash(amount) [amount > 0]

@enduml
